puntos: El jurista consideró necesario que la ciudadanía conozca no solo a los candidatos al Gobierno Regional, sino también a los equipos que eventualmente asumirían la gestión pública.

items.sintesis: El Ejército israelí investiga denuncias sobre el uso de palestinos como escudos humanos durante sus operaciones en Gaza y Cisjordania. El diario Haaretz adelantó este martes la información, confirmada a EFE por una fuente militar, de que el Ejército israelí investiga si “existía una práctica más generalizada” respecto al uso de civiles palestinos en sus operaciones, una práctica por la que se han abierto desde octubre de 2023 un total de 16 investigaciones penales: diez en Gaza y seis en Cisjordania.

Pese a que el uso de escudos humanos está oficialmente prohibido y es considerado ilegal por el Ejército, ningún soldado ha sido procesado por ello, indica Haaretz.

puntos: Prime minister Anwar Ibrahim’s announcement comes days after the ICJ found Myanmar had committed genocide against the Rohingya minority

items.sintesis: Ukraine’s security service says seven drones were launched from mothership in operation that sank Merkury warship Ukraine has confirmed it deployed naval drones in strikes on two Russian vessels off Libya on Sunday, including one that sank the corvette Merkury, one of Russia’s newest vessels.
puntos: Ukraine’s security service says seven drones were launched from mothership in operation that sank Merkury warship
Ukraine has confirmed it deployed naval drones in strikes on two Russian vessels off Libya on Sunday, including one that sank the corvette Merkury, one of Russia’s newest vessels.
Ukraine’s security service, the SBU, said seven domestically made naval drones were launched from a mothership in the operation, which Volodymyr Zelenskyy described as “exemplary”.

items.titulo_original: Trump administration deported US citizen to Mexico, DoJ admits in court
items.sintesis: Brian Morales García of Texas seeks damages after he was wrongly identified as undocumented in case White House wants dropped The Trump administration recently admitted in federal court that it deported a US citizen to Mexico after American authorities incorrectly concluded he was an undocumented immigrant.
puntos: Brian Morales García of Texas seeks damages after he was wrongly identified as undocumented in case White House wants dropped
The Trump administration recently admitted in federal court that it deported a US citizen to Mexico after American authorities incorrectly concluded he was an undocumented immigrant.

Attorneys for the US justice department made that admission on Friday while requesting the dismissal of a lawsuit for damages that the deported man – Brian José Morales García of Austin, Texas – has been pursuing against the federal government.
